Per-population detail against one clinical variable

Source: R/clinical.R
fig_clinical_detail.Rd

The heatmap says which associations are worth looking at; this shows the data behind them, because a rank correlation of 0.8 on nine points can be one outlier and the scatter is the only place that is visible.

Usage

fig_clinical_detail(
  freq,
  clin_values,
  var_name,
  outfile,
  value_col = NULL,
  ncol = 4L,
  dpi = 200,
  colors = fcs_colors()
)

Arguments

freq

population_frequencies table.

clin_values

named vector sample_id -> value.

var_name

the variable's name.

outfile

path.

value_col

frequency column.

ncol

panels per row.

dpi

resolution.

colors

palette.
